qwen_vision.description: The roof has a noticeable irregularity with a measured depth of 531mm and an inclination of 69.4 degrees, indicating a significant structural issue.
qwen_vision.notes: The measured depth of 531mm is implausible given the visible scale of the ruler (approx. 200mm) and the shadow cast; the volume and area estimates are likely inflated due to 3D reconstruction artifacts.
